tags.gist: Asks FDA to clarify whether pathologists must take diagnostic responsibility for unreviewable foundation-model outputs, keeping accountability for validity and drift with developers.
Asks FDA to separate manufacturer re-benchmarking and monitoring duties from laboratory quality control so pathology practices do not inherit continuous surveillance.
Wants accountability for the final result defined: manufacturers answer for validity and change control, pathologists for interpretation, with evidence available before sign-out.
Wants manufacturers to own model-change detection, re-benchmarking and degradation monitoring, with laboratory quality control kept risk-based and local.
